title: An unanswered approval expires at 72 hours and parks the run for a human
risk: A forgotten approval leaves a task parked forever, and the risky action fires later with nobody accountable.
preconditions: Tenant T1 run orc-approval-exp-* paused on an AUTH-4 refund action created at 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z
Sweep executed at 2026-01-18T11:00:00Z, beyond the 72 hour approval TTL

steps.action: Run the expiry sweep for the tenant
steps.expected: the approval row moves from PENDING to EXPIRED with a decided_at timestamp and the pending queue for the run becomes empty

steps.action: Read the task state after the sweep
steps.expected: the task remains outside running and is either awaiting_human or stopped, never executed

steps.action: Attempt to approve the expired approval
steps.expected: the decision is refused and no dispatch occurs

steps.action: Read the exception list raised for the run
steps.expected: one exception item references the expired approval and the run, so a human can resolve it

assertions: The approval row is EXPIRED with decided_at after the 72 hour TTL, and PENDING count for the run is 0
No dispatch is recorded for the expired action and the task never reports success
Exactly one exception item exists for the expired approval
forbidden: Execute an action whose approval expired unanswered
Silently drop the expired approval without an exception item
evidence: Approval row state transition with timestamps
Exception item for the run plus the zero-dispatch evidence
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped approval and exception rows for orc-approval-exp-*; keep audit entries
automation: Freeze the clock past the TTL and run the real sweep job; the oracle is the approval state plus the exception item and the dispatch count.
